title: Requesting directions
passage: Is the exhibition hall within walking distance? A. The exhibition ends tomorrow. B. About ten minutes along the river. C. The walking tour costs fifteen dollars.
passageZh:
展覽館在步行可到的距離內嗎？
A. 展覽明天結束。
B. 沿河走大約十分鐘。
C. 步行導覽費用是十五元。
